cases.input: Synthetic Example Studio USD 2026-09 break BR-14, already classified: GL-1 debit AR-control 5,600 on Sep 30; subledger AR-1 total 5,000 at Sep 30; difference GL minus subledger = 600. Trace JE-77, source JRN-77, dated Sep 30 shows debit AR-control 600 with memo "FX revaluation"; no rate source, approved FX policy, or reversal record supplied. Read-only trace only. State observed cause vs hypothesis, evidence refs, next owner question/action, and clear-date status.

criteria: Recomputes USD 5,600 - USD 5,000 = USD 600 and shows that JE-77 equals the observed break.
States evidence supports the factual bridge (GL contains JE-77 labeled FX revaluation) but does not prove the rate, policy, correct treatment, or expected reversal; these remain unresolved.
Suggests the controller obtain approved rate/policy and inspect subsequent reversal; clear date remains unknown; no journal adjustment or suppression.
